text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — want to run a compact campaign next month for the new "apprentice-labs" reference kit: 3 short tutorials, one micro-benchmark narrative (Benchlight), and a 45-min webinar. Goal: drive OSS engagement + gated leads for trial credits. Thoughts?

Deepak Rao: Love it. Can we make the tutorials interactive notebooks? Jupyter + Colab + a tiny Docker container. People can run locally.

Samir Patel: +1. Also add a tiny throughput/latency benchmark that shows diff between quantization modes. Benchlight should be reproducible with a 1-page script.

Lucy Gomez: I'll sketch hero visuals and a two-line value prop — "Ship LLM features with predictable cost and latency". Need final copy by next Wed to hit the content calendar.

Maya Chen: Copy points — audience = ML engs & platform teams. CTA variants: 1) Try the starter kit (no signup) 2) Join webinar (gated) 3) Request Dedicated trial (sales follow-up). We need inbound routing for (2) and (3).

Tom Sullivan: For routing, recommend: webinar signups -> Marketo form -> Zap -> Salesforce lead + add "webinar_apprentice_labs" tag. Dedicated trial -> direct SRE/solutions-eng queue. I can drop a sample Zapier/ webhook snippet.

Samir Patel: Sample webhook JSON works. Also we should capture model/seq_len/quant bits in the signup metadata for better follow-ups.

Tom Sullivan: Here is a tiny webhook mapping we tested: ```json
{
  "source": "apprentice-webinar",
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "interest": "webinar|dedicated|starter",
  "runs": { "model": "{{model}}", "seq_len": "{{seq_len}}", "quant": "{{quant}}" }
}
```

Deepak Rao: Nice. For the micro-benchmark narrative (Benchlight) we should highlight 3 configs: FP16 baseline, int8 quant, and int4 (if available). Show token/sec, median latency P50/P95, and cost per 1k tokens. One chart and one short table.

Lucy Gomez: Visual plan: 1 hero chart (tokens/sec vs config), 2-callout cards (cost & latency), 3-step quickstart card. I can mock assets by Fri.

Maya Chen: Webinar format idea: 20m demo (refapp + benchlight), 15m engineering deep-dive (quant + caching), 10m live Q&A. Panel: Deepak + Samir + product PM. Can launch email + community post + Twitter thread.

Samir Patel: For demo, I'll prepare a script that runs the benchlight script live against hosted API and Dedicated (if allowed). Need a stable model version pinned. Any preferences?

Deepak Rao: Use a small open model (e.g., vicuna-7b variant) that we can quantize and that runs on both Hosted and Dedicated test infra. Keep inputs deterministic.

Maya Chen: Timeline: content freeze in 10 days, visual assets by Fri, registration page up in 12 days, webinar in 21 days. Is that tight?

Tom Sullivan: Ops note: enable a canary route for webinar demo so live demo falls back to recorded trace if infra hiccups. I'll add the fallback policy.

Lucy Gomez: I'll write 2 headline options for A/B: 
- "Apprentice Labs: Build and benchmark LLM features in minutes"
- "Benchlight: See how quant and caching change real costs"
Pick which tests better with devs.

Deepak Rao: Also propose a small code lab: "From zero to 100 req/s with caching". Short prereqs, 25-min hands-on. That can be follow-up to webinar.

Maya Chen: Great. Action items:
- Maya: draft launch post + email sequence (due in 7 days)
- Lucy: visuals + hero chart mock (due Fri)
- Deepak: notebook + code lab outline (due in 7 days)
- Samir: benchlight script + demo script (due in 9 days)
- Tom: implement signup routing + fallback policy (due in 5 days)

Samir Patel: I'll check in on infra quotas for Dedicated demo. If not available, we'll record the run but reveal the raw numbers live.

launch-bot: Event created "Apprentice Labs launch planning" on 2024-08-09 15:00 UTC. Attendees: Maya Chen, Deepak Rao, Samir Patel, Lucy Gomez, Tom Sullivan.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — can we do a quick stand tomorrow to confirm blockers? 15 minutes.

Tom Sullivan: I'm good. I'll post the routing doc in #eng-sre after it's ready.

Deepak Rao: I'll spin up the Colab and share links as soon as it's runnable. :rocket: 

Lucy Gomez: Will iterate on the hero copy and mock and drop in the drive. :art: 

Samir Patel: Adding a tiny reproducibility note to the benchlight README: seed values, env vars, and the command to run. Keeps the tutorial trustworthy.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Meeting tomorrow 09:15 PT. Closing thread for now, will reopen with assets. :calendar:
